transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called this finalization huddle to go over the callback package for the Mara Quill role before I issue the call sheet. We've got three finalists, and the draft plan has us in Studio 4 on June 18, 9 AM to 1 PM, using the North Wall excerpt, an optional movement exercise, and recorded auditions for internal review. I'd like to hear from each of you — counsel, stunt, dialect, and studio scheduling — on whether you see any issues with the package as drafted. Once everyone's signed off, I'll finalize and issue the call sheet.

transcript.text: I need to flag something before we sign off.
